title: Speedy's background and the dog Chappy
summary: Violet Speedy's real name Lillian Sherman, her Georgia property and their life together.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: What was Speedy doing when you met her? Was she in a show, or what?
No, she was -- let me back up awhile. That was her stage name, Violet Speedy, but her original name was Lillian Sherman.
And she's a descendant of the guy that went through Georgia, General Sherman.
And on the other side -- not on the white side, on the other side. And that's how she had all this property in Georgia.
It was handed down through the generations, you know?
I never knew any of that. Gee.

Because I used to laugh sometimes, she would go from one extreme to another. Sometimes she was just like a little girl and other times she was tough. And we had a little Scotty dog we called Chappy, but Chappy really could control her, and sometimes I would just talk to the dog. I said, 'Man, will you help me to do something with this woman here?'
Because I can't seem to -- on certain days, you know, I'd say, 'I can't get through to her.' And Chappy would look at me and roll over on the floor, you know?
Oh, yeah. We had a nice life, a very nice life. And not -- not one regret, because -- well, she was what I needed, and evidently I was what she needed.
